conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% per month. It significantly reduces leverage and concentrates on stable income and broad market exposure. Expect lower volatility but also limited upside potential.

income.read: This income plan aims to park cash for yield, targeting ~1% per month.
